name: BrightBean Studio
description: Self-hosted social media management: plan, schedule, approve and publish posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky and more, with a private PostgreSQL database and background publishing worker.

settings.label: Administrator and email
settings.description: The administrator account is created on first start. Email is optional but needed for password resets and invitations.

fields.label: Administrator email
fields.help: You sign in with this address and the generated password on the Connection card.

fields.label: SMTP host
fields.help: Leave empty to skip outgoing email.

services.name: brightbean

build.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PORT=8000 \
    MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq-dev gcc curl ca-certificates ffmpeg \
    && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ARG BRIGHTBEAN_REF=1d11c52007a3f714979ff1b071d153e69a8c274a
RUN curl -fsSL "https://codeload.github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio/tar.gz/${BRIGHTBEAN_REF}" | tar -xz --strip-components=1
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --default-timeout=120 --retries 8 -r requirements.txt
RUN cd theme/static_src && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
COPY brightbean/openship_settings.py config/settings/openship.py
RUN DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.openship SECRET_KEY=build-placeholder DATABASE_URL=sqlite:////tmp/build.db python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
RUN groupadd --system --gid 1001 app && useradd --system --uid 1001 --gid app --home-dir /app --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app \
    && mkdir -p /app/media /app/staticfiles && chown -R app:app /app/media /app/staticfiles
USER app
EXPOSE 8000

files.content:
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from .production import *  # noqa: F401,F403

# Open-ship install: the public host comes from APP_URL, so ALLOWED_HOSTS and
# CSRF follow the address the app was installed on. HTTPS-only behaviour stays
# on whenever APP_URL is https; a plain-http (port mode) install turns the
# redirect and secure cookies off so it can be used at all.
_url = urlparse(APP_URL)  # noqa: F405
ALLOWED_HOSTS = sorted({h for h in [_url.hostname, "127.0.0.1", "localhost", *ALLOWED_HOSTS] if h})  # noqa: F405
if _url.scheme and _url.hostname:
    CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS = [f"{_url.scheme}://{_url.netloc}"]
if _url.scheme != "https":
    SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = False
    SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 0
    SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS = False
    SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD = False
    SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = False
    CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = False

entrypointArgv:
set -e
python manage.py migrate --noinput
python manage.py createsuperuser --noinput || true
python manage.py run_studio_worker & worker=$!
gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 --workers 1 --threads 4 & web=$!
trap 'kill $worker $web 2>/dev/null' TERM INT
wait -n $worker $web
code=$?
kill $worker $web 2>/dev/null
exit $code
